banner: PRODUCT MANAGER | AI PRODUCT STRATEGY & AGENTIC SYSTEMS
summary: Product manager who builds data-driven product strategy from user, usage, and market insights, then validates the end-to-end use cases and workflows behind it until the gaps are visible. Conducted comparative analysis of legacy and next-generation systems and delivered structured gap assessments that exposed functional and performance inefficiencies, and turned those workflow gaps into a prioritized roadmap that moved 75 enterprise customers with zero operational downtime. Hands-on with agentic systems as a builder rather than a reviewer: founded SpecHawk, an AI-powered deploy-aware no-code agentic QA platform, and grounded an AI test case generator in retrieval-augmented generation over roughly 2,000 of the team’s own ticket-to-test conversions so generated output followed house conventions. Runs direct customer discovery, four design partners recruited and looped weekly on real usage, and partners across engineering, QA, marketing, and executive leadership to execute and monitor product performance. Works in TypeScript, Node.js, Python and Java across product strategy, platform integration, and software delivery.

roles.lede: Defined product strategy and roadmap for a next-generation aviation platform, validated end-to-end use cases and workflows against the legacy system to surface gaps, and partnered across engineering, QA, and go-to-market stakeholders to execute and monitor delivery.
bullets: Owned the enterprise migration roadmap end to end, onboarded 75 customers from competing FBO platforms to TFBO Next-Gen, and sustained 104% YoY ARR growth over two consecutive years.

Directed QA resource planning and the automated testing strategy that raised test coverage from 62% to 81%, trading breadth of coverage against confidence in each individual result while holding enterprise-grade release stability and regression quality assurance.

Owned the product side of an infrastructure migration from a legacy monolithic aviation platform to a domain-driven microservices architecture using Java, Spring Boot, TypeScript, and Angular, implementing reusable RESTful APIs, caching, and lazy loading to reduce data retrieval latency by 68% and eliminate enterprise system timeouts.

Directed a feature parity program for TFBO Next-Gen through influence without authority over engineering, translating workflow gaps into prioritized requirements, acceptance criteria and migration sequencing so 75 enterprise customers moved with zero operational downtime.

Validated end-to-end TFBO Next-Gen use cases against legacy workflows to surface feature gaps, then aligned engineering, QA, and go-to-market stakeholders on delivery priorities and release monitoring.

Removed a two-week onboarding bottleneck by automating the data injection ETL rather than asking for headcount, taking capacity from over two weeks per customer to three customers per day and making the 75-customer program feasible.
Optimized engineering delivery velocity through AI-driven workflow integration to accelerate the redesign and release of the Invoicing module by five months and reduce customer churn significantly.

bullets: Replaced 25 separate weekly revenue emails to the CEO of a top-two enterprise account with a single dynamic PowerBI digest covering cumulative revenue and per-location drill-down, verifying every figure against raw Snowflake data before it reached an executive inbox.
